hero.review: run, walk, idle in place and seamless; flaw: Tripo's skinning ties the rifle to the right arm, so in the run it swings with the arm instead of being held

stalker.review: walk and run read well: an upright stride with the scythe blades swinging, and a forward-leaning sprint

colossus.rejected: Tripo's quadruped auto-rig (v2.5-20260210, two rigs: 2cd317e8 and 50ca3f83) does not fit this body: the first walk yawed the body and crumpled the legs, the second stretches a front leg into a smeared slab every step; Tripo's own skinned mesh shows the same tearing, so it is the rig, not the weight transfer. No VAT is shipped; the procedural leg animation stays.

attempts.verdict: rejected: a front leg stretches into a slab

scuttler.review: hexapod walk: the legs step, the body stays put; the eye faces shimmer slightly; the tick has eight legs, the hexapod rig drives six of them

seeker.rejected: Tripo rig-check (free) says the seeker is not riggable (riggable false, rig_type others), and the API has no hover or idle preset for non-biped rigs. No VAT; the procedural ring/fin animation stays.
